params.caption: 🎮 Dark Souls 2 and 3 servers are back online After about two weeks offline, the online features of Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3 have returned. FromSoftware brought them back once it finished investigating security vulnerabilities, so co-op and PvP are available again. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 18:21 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #DarkSouls #FromSoftware #GamingNews
